messages.body:
Welcome aboard, pilot.

The School of Applied Knowledge has assigned you a hangar at Todaki VI - Moon 1. Your training plan is ready; keep the skill queue running at all times, even while you sleep.

Fly safe,
Instructor Teva Raskold
messages.subject: Welcome to the School of Applied Knowledge

messages.body:
Reminder for the circle: the shared research slots at the home station free up on Thursday. If you have blueprint copies queued, check their material efficiency before you start the next run.

Ilmari
messages.subject: Research slots open on Thursday

messages.body:
Hi,

Tritanium buy orders in the region are sitting well above their weekly average. If you have ore in your hangar, refining and selling now looks better than hauling it to a trade hub.

Sella
messages.subject: Market tip: Tritanium is up

messages.body: New pilot roam this weekend, 19:00 EVE time, forming at the home station. Bring a fitted frigate, a spare ship and some cheap ammunition. No experience needed; we will explain everything on comms.
messages.subject: Weekend roam for new pilots

messages.body:
Your courier contract arrived intact and on time. Thank you for the quick delivery; I will send the next one your way.

Regards,
Orvan Dekker
messages.subject: Courier contract delivered

messages.body: Two data sites showed up two jumps from the home station. Relic and data analyzers work well with a scanning frigate. Remember to fit a cloak if you go deeper into low security space.
messages.subject: Exploration sites nearby

messages.body:
Quick reminder: manufacturing jobs keep running while you are offline, but finished items wait at the facility until you deliver them. Check the industry window before you undock.

Ilmari
messages.subject: Deliver your finished jobs

messages.body:
For a new pilot: train the core fitting skills first (CPU Management, Power Grid Management), then the support skills for your ship. They pay off in every ship you will ever fly.

Teva
messages.subject: Which skills to train next
